verdicts.reason: A rewraps the headline into four bold lines that fill the portrait width, and the CTA stays well proportioned, so the hierarchy is strong. Its flaw is that the group sits low: about 170px of space on top against roughly 50px under the CTA, so it looks bottom-heavy. B keeps the landscape wrap at a smaller size and places the whole group in the upper half, which leaves about 280px of empty orange at the bottom and makes it look like the original pasted onto a taller canvas. B's CTA label is also undersized for its button.
